description: Agent Migration: submit the verification run after one move: each check with its kind (a record count, a sampled record, a balance, a field meaning spot-check, a field presence check, the target loads, a smoke test or other), what it covers, the mapped field it reads, the value on the source and on the target, whether they matched and when it ran; optionally what moved, the mapped fields, and when the source data was deleted. The signed report lists every check as a matched, mismatched or unstated comparison, a comparison run after deletion, or not a comparison at all, gives the items and mapped fields with the comparisons covering them and the timing against the deletion, and names a move left unchecked: verification that amounts to the target loads with nothing compared against the source, comparisons run after the source was already deleted, and comparisons that found the target differs; then moved items no comparison covers and mapped fields checked only for presence, never for meaning, with the fix for each. Counts and balances compare by their values; samples and meaning spot-checks state whether they matched. What a receiver could run on day one of a handover is wever_handover-check, and whether a supplied rollback was rehearsed is wever_rollback-path-check. Verdict post_move_unchecked, post_move_gaps, post_move_unverified or post_move_verified. POST /api/migration-verify-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write, and no data is moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-migration-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-migration/.
